The '''Shining Man's vitalicron''' was constructed for [[Albathius]], also known as the "Shining Man", at the [[Shrine of Healing|Wellspring of the Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]] and was kept in there until recovered by [[Cipher Nine]].
